title: 第一卷 第46章 七品初期第一卷 第45章 幻境吗
lines: 八品初期在这种战场里面还是太弱了，一点自保能力都没有。
甚至在刚才，有两名士兵为了救秦烈，献出了自己的生命。
他也不想在这种时候拖别人的后腿。
秦烈咬紧牙关。
“加点。”
面板展开。
【境界：八品初期】
功法：基础炼体诀·小成】
秦烈没有犹豫。
“提升基础炼体诀。”
现在最重要的不是提升气血值，而是要把自己的品级拉上去。
下一刻，自由属性点开始下降。
【消耗自由属性点：50】
【基础炼体诀·小成【表情】基础炼体诀·大成】
【境界提升】
【八品初期【表情】八品后期】
滚烫的气血从身体深处涌出来，境界也提升到了八品后期。
还差一百点。
再攒一百点，他就能踏进七品初期。
就差十多点了，一会下一轮进攻，一定要把自己的品阶提升到七品初期。
没等秦烈把面板收起来，城墙下再次传来了妖族的嘶吼。
刚才还靠墙休息的断风营士卒立马站了起来。
“敌袭！敌袭！准备作战！”
城墙下的妖族再次冲了上来，这一次比刚才那一波还要猛烈。
城墙上的士兵刚喘了几口气，这个时候已经全部站了起来。
没有时间准备，只要战鼓一响，他们就会重新回到防线。
秦烈也握紧了自己手里的长刀，八品后期的气血在体内流动，他能明显感觉自己比刚才强了不少。
身上的伤口还在疼，但是已经不影响他的行动了。
“堵住缺口，别让这群畜生上来！”
这个时候秦烈没有再愣神，提着刀就跟了上去。
一只低等妖兽刚刚翻上墙头，还没站稳，秦烈就冲到了它面前。
长刀从侧面斩过，刀锋砍进妖兽的脖子里。
妖兽还想挣扎，秦烈一脚踹在它的胸口，把它从城墙上踹了下去。
【击杀低等妖兽】
【获得自由属性点+0.3】
来不及放松，城墙上的妖物实在是太多了，他刚杀完一只，又扑过来一只。
城墙另一边突然传来一声惨叫。
秦烈猛地转头看过去。
content_en:
;;
In the early stage of eighth level, he is still too weak in this kind of battlefield and has no ability to protect himself at all.
Even just now, two soldiers sacrificed their lives to save Qin Lie.
He also didn't want to hold others back at this time.
Qin Lie gritted his teeth.
"Add more."
The panel expands.
[Realm: Early stage of eighth grade]
Kung Fu: Basic Body Training Technique·Xiao Cheng]
[Free attribute points: 132.95]
Qin Lie did not hesitate.
"Improve the basic body refining technique."
The most important thing now is not to increase the health value, but to raise one's own level.
The next moment, the free attribute points began to decrease.
[Consumption of free attribute points: 50]
[Basic Body Refining Technique·Small Success [Expression]Basic Body Refining Technique·Dacheng]
[Enhancement of Realm]
[Eighth-grade early stage [expression] Eighth-grade late stage]
[Free attribute points: 82.95]
Hot Qi and blood surged out from the depths of his body, and his realm was promoted to the late eighth stage.
One hundred points to go.
If he saves another hundred points, he will be able to enter the early stage of seventh level.
It's just over ten points away. In the next round of attacks, you must raise your level to the early stage of seventh level.
Before Qin Lie could put away the panel, the roar of the demon race came from under the city wall again.
The Duanfeng Camp soldiers who had been resting against the wall just now stood up immediately.
"Enemy attack! Enemy attack! Prepare for battle!"
The monsters under the city wall rushed up again, this time even more violent than the previous wave.
The soldiers on the city wall just took a few breaths, and now they all stood up.
There was no time to prepare; as soon as the drums sounded, they would be back on the defensive line.
Qin Lie also tightened his grip on the long knife in his hand. The Qi and blood of the late eighth grade were flowing in his body. He could clearly feel that he was much stronger than before.
The wounds on his body still hurt, but they no longer affected his movements.
"Block the gap and don't let these beasts come up!"
At this time, Qin Lie was no longer stunned and followed him with the knife.
A low-level monster had just climbed up the wall and before it could stand still, Qin Lie rushed in front of it.
The long knife slashed across the side, and the blade cut into the monster's neck.
The monster still wanted to struggle, but Qin Lie kicked it in the chest, knocking it off the city wall.
[Kill low-level monsters]
[Get free attribute points +0.3]
There was no time to relax. There were too many monsters on the city wall. As soon as he killed one, another one pounced on him.
A scream suddenly came from the other side of the city wall.
Qin Lie suddenly turned his head and looked over.
